environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_ADS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: App ID of your application (developers.mercadolibre.com > My applications); sent as client_id in the token request body.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Secret Key of the same application; sent as client_secret in the token request body.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token (TG-...) from a one-time authorization-code consent by the advertiser's ADMIN account (Product Ads enabled under Mi perfil > Publicidad) (valid 6 months). It is SINGLE-USE: every refresh returns a new access token (6 h) and a new refresh token, and only the last one issued is accepted. The runtime keeps a rotated refresh token in memory; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR to also save it (<dir>/<platform>.json, mode 0600) so it is preferred over this variable on the next start. Without the state directory, a restart after the first refresh needs a fresh refresh token.
